findings.summary: The captured large request and native small Automotive browser journey cannot pass model review because generated controller/status messages lack confirmed consumers.
findings.cause: Communication design rule 14 forbids the old automatic diagnostic/gateway monitoring consumer. wizard_communication.communication_plan now leaves those recipients UNRESOLVED and contract_findings rejects them; legacy positive fixtures still assume full validation. The native small browser case supplies prose but no confirmed per-message display/functional destinations.
findings.impact: 10 backend failures, 4 fixture setup errors, 2 browser failures, large HTTP acceptance failure. Small HTTP with explicit routes and both nonautomotive browser scenarios pass.
findings.required_resolution: Reconcile the unchanged captured acceptance requirement with explicit reviewed status recipients or an explicit local-output decision; preserve the original scenario as a negative/review-gate regression. Do not invent receivers or weaken validation to turn this green.

findings.summary: Expected invalid-input and missing-resource cases escape as HTTP 500.
findings.cause: ValueError from record_hardware_fact is not mapped, get_goal raises generic LookupError, structure_preview indexes missing request fields before the domain validator, and plan_zoning indexes absent topology nodes/edges.
findings.required_resolution: Use existing domain validation/not-found errors, retain conflict responses and rollback, and reject missing topology explicitly.

findings.summary: Browsing storage directories on a new project returns 503 before its first simulation has created the default runs directory.
findings.cause: TraceStorage.directories calls scandir on a lazily-created default project output directory.
findings.required_resolution: Represent an absent unused default folder as an empty listing without hiding explicit unavailable custom storage or permission errors.

limits: Development test image built from current source with existing runtime dependencies; no release PASS.
Local-model quality and optional large-result benchmark were explicitly skipped by existing suite; no LLM-quality acceptance claimed.
68 existing browser cases include 40 inventory checks, not 40 complete nine-stage projects.
774 Python syntax checks and targeted contract/source review are not an exhaustive proof of every possible code path.
